signIn.subject: Sign in to Slotly
signIn.title: Sign in to Slotly
signIn.intro: Click the button to sign in, or enter the code:
signIn.note: The link and code are valid for 1 hour. If you did not request this, you can ignore this email.

signUp.subject: Confirm your email for Slotly
signUp.title: Confirm your email
signUp.intro: Click the button to confirm your address, or enter the code:
signUp.note: The link and code are valid for 1 hour. If you did not sign up for Slotly, you can ignore this email.

booking.subject: Confirm your booking on Slotly
booking.title: Confirm your booking
booking.intro: Check the details and click the button to confirm your booking, or enter the code on the booking page:
booking.note: We are holding this time for you until {time} ({zone}). If you did not book, you can ignore this email.

emailChangeNew.subject: Confirm your new email for Slotly
emailChangeNew.title: Confirm your new email
emailChangeNew.intro: Click the button to sign in to Slotly with {email} from now on.
emailChangeNew.note: The link is valid for 1 hour. If you did not change your email, you can ignore this email.

emailChangeCurrent.subject: Confirm the email change on Slotly
emailChangeCurrent.title: Confirm the email change
emailChangeCurrent.intro: Your Slotly account asked to change its address to {email}. If this was you, click the button.
emailChangeCurrent.note: The link is valid for 1 hour. If this was not you, do nothing and your address stays the same.

decisionNeeded.subject: New booking: {client}
decisionNeeded.title: A new booking waits for your decision
decisionNeeded.intro: You have a new booking. Confirm or decline it in your account.
decisionNeeded.note: If you do not answer by {time} ({zone}), the booking is cancelled automatically.

confirmed.subject: Your booking is confirmed
confirmed.title: Booking confirmed
confirmed.intro: The master confirmed your booking. See you!

declined.subject: Your booking was declined
declined.title: Booking declined
declined.intro: The master cannot see you at this time. You can pick another time on the master's page.

cancelledByMaster.subject: Your booking was cancelled
cancelledByMaster.title: Booking cancelled
cancelledByMaster.intro: The master cancelled your booking. You can pick another time on the master's page.

cancelledByClient.subject: Booking cancelled: {client}
cancelledByClient.title: A client cancelled a booking
cancelledByClient.intro: The client cancelled the booking, so this time is free again.

rescheduledByMaster.subject: Your booking was moved
rescheduledByMaster.title: Booking moved
rescheduledByMaster.intro: The master moved your booking to another time.

rescheduledByClient.subject: Booking moved: {client}
rescheduledByClient.title: A client moved a booking
rescheduledByClient.intro: The client moved the booking to another time.
rescheduledByClient.note: The new time waits for your decision until {time} ({zone}).

masterDidNotRespond.subject: Your booking was cancelled
masterDidNotRespond.title: The master did not respond in time
masterDidNotRespond.intro: The master did not answer your booking in time, so it was cancelled. You can pick another time on the master's page.
